product_metadata.title: HOMCOM Natural Wood Vintage Table with Shelves, TV Cabinet with Sliding Door, Back Cable Hole for Living Room, Wood
features: VINTAGE STYLE: With the vintage table with wood grain outlook and the steel sliding door accessories, it's not just a functional TV cabinet, but also an eye-catching living room decoration.

AMPLE STORAGE SPACE: Combines with two open shelves and two-door cabinets for media storage. Rather than a normal TV stand, it is also very helpful to make your personal items well organized and to keep your living room tidy.

USER FRIENDLY: The smooth sliding door design is convenient to open the cabinet and gives you that farmhouse tv stand style! The cable hole design in the back helps your tabletop tidy, clean, and bright.

HIGH-QUALITY MATERIAL: P2 grade particleboard and steel feet ensure its high stability and long durability, provides a great load capacity to hold multiple heavy things. A strong and sturdy wood tv stand is the way to go.
DIMENSION: Overall Dimension: 58" W x 15.5" D x 24" H. Suitable for TVs of max. size 65". Max. Load: (overall) 132lbs, (drawer) 22lbs.
description: The vintage wood TV stand with media storage from HOMCOM is very practical with 2 cabinets, 2 storage shelves, and also very eye-catching by the retro wood grain design. The ample storage space helps you to keep your items organized and your living room tidy. The TV stand is user-friendly with the smooth sliding doors and the back cable hole design. It fits well in your living room, bedroom, and anywhere you need it.

● Vintage table design with the natural color combination is ideal for household using - Quality material offers high stability and long durability - Ample storage space is helpful for saving space - Great load capacity enough to hold multiple heavy items - Elevated design for convenient cleaning - Cable hole in the back lets cables get organized and the tabletop clean and tidy

● Color: Natural Wood - Material: P2 Grade Particleboard, Steel - Overall Dimensions: 58" W x 15.5" D x 24" H - Shelf Size: 56" W x 36" D x 14.5" / 22.5" H - Door Cabinet Inner Size: 16.5" W x 14.5" T x 15" H - Sliding Door Size: 17.25" W x 15.5" H - Cable Hole Size: 2" - Weight Capacity: (overall) 132lbs, (shelf) 22lbs
